_help: Devil Fruits found in Rare Chests. Every fruit exists once per run: once a Nakama eats it, it leaves the chest pool. Each Nakama can eat only one. atk and hp are multipliers applied permanently to the Nakama that eats it. fx are the fruit's special powers in battle (see _fx). desc is the flavor text; the effect text is generated from the numbers, so you never have to write it. Text fields accept a plain string or {"en":"...","es":"..."}. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

_fruit_fields.name: string or {en,es}
_fruit_fields.type: logia | paramecia | zoan | ancientZoan | mythicalZoan (logia also gives +10% dodge automatically)
_fruit_fields.color: hex color of the fruit orb
_fruit_fields.weight: relative chance of appearing in a chest (default 1)

desc.en: Fire Fist: flames wash over the whole enemy line.
desc.es: Puño de Fuego: las llamas bañan a toda la fila enemiga.

desc.en: Dries the life out of whatever it touches.
desc.es: Seca la vida de todo lo que toca.

desc.en: Lightning strikes first and paralyzes.
desc.es: El rayo golpea primero y paraliza.

desc.en: Darkness swallows powers and resistances alike.
desc.es: La oscuridad se traga poderes y resistencias.

desc.en: Moves at the speed of light: nobody acts before you.
desc.es: Se mueve a la velocidad de la luz: nadie actúa antes que tú.

desc.en: Burns the enemy, and whoever dares to hit back.
desc.es: Quema al enemigo y a quien se atreva a golpear de vuelta.

desc.en: Freezes enemies in place behind a wall of ice.
desc.es: Congela a los enemigos tras un muro de hielo.

desc.en: A body of smoke that attacks cannot grab.
desc.es: Un cuerpo de humo que los ataques no pueden agarrar.

desc.en: A poisonous cloud that seeps through any guard.
desc.es: Una nube venenosa que se cuela por cualquier guardia.

desc.en: A rubber body that bounces blows and stretches for a second hit.
desc.es: Un cuerpo de goma que rebota los golpes y se estira para un segundo ataque.

desc.en: Extra arms bloom wherever they are needed.
desc.es: Brotan brazos extra donde hacen falta.

desc.en: A body that blades cannot cut.
desc.es: Un cuerpo que las espadas no pueden cortar.

desc.en: The Operating Room mends the whole crew and speeds up their rhythm.
desc.es: El Quirófano repara a toda la tripulación y acelera su ritmo.

desc.en: Razor strings bind the target and cut the rest.
desc.es: Hilos afilados que atan al objetivo y cortan al resto.

desc.en: The strongest quake: the whole sea shakes.
desc.es: El mayor terremoto: todo el mar tiembla.

desc.en: Invisible barriers: it draws the blows and shields its friends.
desc.es: Barreras invisibles: atrae los golpes y protege a sus amigos.

desc.en: Repels anything, even the blow that was about to land.
desc.es: Repele cualquier cosa, incluso el golpe que iba a caer.

desc.en: Enemies freeze, charmed, and strike with less heart.
desc.es: Los enemigos se quedan quietos, hechizados, y golpean con menos ganas.

desc.en: Hardened wax armor that glues the enemy down.
desc.es: Armadura de cera endurecida que pega al enemigo al suelo.

desc.en: Ghosts drain the will to fight from every enemy.
desc.es: Los fantasmas drenan las ganas de pelear de todos los enemigos.

desc.en: Venom that spreads to everyone and ignores any defense.
desc.es: Veneno que se extiende a todos e ignora cualquier defensa.

desc.en: Dies once, and comes back for another song.
desc.es: Muere una vez y vuelve para otra canción.

desc.en: Sticky, stretchy and hard to hit.
desc.es: Pegajoso, elástico y difícil de golpear.

desc.en: Songs of courage: the whole crew hits harder.
desc.es: Canciones de valor: toda la tripulación golpea más fuerte.

desc.en: A body of steel blades that cuts through anything.
desc.es: Un cuerpo de cuchillas de acero que corta cualquier cosa.

desc.en: Memories of past fights: specials charge much faster.
desc.es: Recuerdos de combates pasados: los especiales se cargan mucho antes.

desc.en: A reindeer with a human mind: heals itself and thinks fast.
desc.es: Un reno con mente humana: se cura solo y piensa rápido.

desc.en: A predator: fast, precise and merciless.
desc.es: Un depredador: rápido, preciso y despiadado.

desc.en: Long legs and quick, repeated kicks.
desc.es: Patas largas y patadas rápidas y repetidas.

desc.en: A walking wall that draws every enemy attack.
desc.es: Un muro andante que atrae todos los ataques enemigos.

desc.en: Brutal bites that heal the beast.
desc.es: Mordiscos brutales que curan a la bestia.

desc.en: The Sun God: a body of joy that no one can pin down.
desc.es: El Dios Sol: un cuerpo de pura alegría que nadie logra atrapar.

desc.en: Blue flames that heal and bring the fallen back.
desc.es: Llamas azules que curan y devuelven a los caídos.

name.es: Fruta Uo Uo, Modelo: Dragón Azul

desc.en: The legendary Azure Dragon: hits everyone and shrugs off the rest.
desc.es: El legendario Dragón Azul: golpea a todos y se ríe del resto.

name.en: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi no Makami
name.es: Fruta Inu Inu, Modelo: Okuchi no Makami

desc.en: The wolf-god of the mountains: fast, freezing, protective.
desc.es: El dios lobo de las montañas: veloz, helado y protector.

desc.en: A giant golden Buddha whose shockwaves mend and protect.
desc.es: Un Buda dorado gigante cuyas ondas de choque curan y protegen.

_fx.charge: extra special-bar charge per round (a normal round gives 16)
_fx.regen: heals this fraction of max HP every round
_fx.guard: fraction of damage taken that is ignored (0.2 = -20%)
_fx.lifesteal: heals this fraction of the damage it deals
_fx.dbl: chance to strike a second time for 60% damage
_fx.splash: fraction of the damage dealt that also hits every other enemy
_fx.stun: chance to stun the target on a hit (bosses resist)
_fx.rez: revives once per battle with this fraction of max HP
_fx.thorns: reflects this fraction of the damage it takes
_fx.aggro: multiplier on how often enemies pick it as a target
_fx.team: {atk, guard, regen, dodge, crit, charge, foeAtk}: auras for the WHOLE crew while this nakama fights (foeAtk = enemies deal less damage)
